name: tienda-de-maquillaje
description: Tienda online de maquillaje para Colombia (monorepo: web + api + shared).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tienda/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tienda/shared" "npm run dev -w @tienda/api" "npm run dev -w @tienda/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @tienda/shared && npm run dev -w @tienda/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @tienda/shared && npm run dev -w @tienda/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tienda/shared && npm run build -w @tienda/api && npm run build -w @tienda/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tienda/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
